heading: top-left
name: 兩列方形圖片網格（手機改兩列橫向滑動）
desc: 標題靠左，下方是兩列等大的方形圖片網格，右下角一個文字連結；手機改為兩列一起橫向滑動，搭配箭頭按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方不留白，標題貼齊區塊的上緣；下方保留一般的留白。區塊上方靠左放標題組，標題組包含標題（可多行），沒有其他元素時省略；標題明顯小於下方的圖片。標題下方是多個項目排成的網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，左緣和標題對齊：共兩列，每列數個，所有項目等寬、等高，都是方形圖片，項目沒有外框，也沒有文字。每張圖片右上角可疊一個小圖示，部分圖片可改在中央疊一個圓形播放圖示，沒有時省略。網格下方靠右可放一個小型文字連結，右緣對齊網格右緣，沒有時省略。
mobile: 標題組維持在上方靠左，區塊上方仍不留白。網格改為兩列一起橫向滑動：一次露出兩欄方形圖片，右側露出下一欄的一部分，被畫面右緣裁切，左側仍對齊內容寬度。網格下方靠右放一組左右箭頭按鈕，每次切換一欄，到第一欄或最後一欄時停住，該方向的箭頭變為停用，不循環。文字連結移到箭頭按鈕下方，仍靠右。

en.name: Two-row square image grid (two-row horizontal swipe on mobile)
en.desc: A left-aligned title above a two-row grid of equal square images, with a text link at the bottom right; on mobile both rows swipe horizontally together, with arrow buttons.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section has no spacing at the top: the title is flush with the top edge of the section, while the bottom keeps the usual spacing. Place the heading group at the top, aligned left; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), with other elements omitted when there is no content; the title is clearly smaller than the images below. Below the title, multiple items form a grid aligned to the page content width, its left edge aligned with the title: two rows, several items per row, all items equal in width and height, each a square image, with no frame and no text. Optionally overlay a small icon at the top-right corner of each image, and on some images a circular play icon at the center instead; omit them when there is no content. Optionally place a small text link at the bottom right below the grid, its right edge aligned with the right edge of the grid; omit it when there is no content.
en.mobile: The heading group stays at the top, aligned left, still with no spacing at the top of the section. The grid becomes a horizontal swipe in which both rows move together: two columns of square images are visible at a time, with part of the next column peeking in on the right, cropped by the right edge of the viewport, while the left side stays aligned to the content width. Below the grid, at the right, place a pair of left and right arrow buttons that switch one column at a time; at the first or last column the carousel stops and the arrow for that direction becomes disabled, without looping. The text link moves below the arrow buttons, still aligned right.

extras.name: 圖片逐格由上往下揭開
extras.prompt: 捲動到網格進入畫面時，每張圖片由上往下逐漸揭開（從上緣開始露出，直到整張完整出現），各格依序錯開開始，播放一次；揭開由進入畫面觸發，依時間播放，不跟著捲動進度。
extras.mobile: 手機保留同樣的揭開效果，各格依序錯開。

en.name: Images reveal top-down, one by one
en.prompt: When the grid scrolls into view, each image is gradually revealed from top to bottom (starting at its top edge until the whole image is visible), with each tile starting slightly after the previous one, playing once; the reveal is triggered on entering the view and plays over time, not tied to scroll progress.
en.mobile: On mobile the same reveal is kept, with the tiles staggered in sequence.
